newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,135 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,135 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,135 contracts compared with 1,998 overnight Thursday.
There were 335 wheat, 674 corn, 884 soybean, 134 soymeal, 53 soyoil, 13 oat, 12 corn calls, one corn put, 26 soybean calls and three soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 6-1/4 cents lower, corn was one to 1-1/2 cents lower and soybeans were 3/4 to 3-1/2 cents lower.
